inspectionCoverage.visualMethod: Directly viewed all four heroes and all static declared previews. Independently verified all-frame sheet cells against raw frames, then viewed all 192 source-sized sheet cells in four state slices. Decoded every MP4 to all 12 frames, inspected four temporal strips, and started the 16 actual MP4 elements through the declared playback index in Chrome; observed their playback states/screenshots. Raw/atlas inspection uses the verified lossless sheets, not editor ratings.

scoreExplanation.shapeVolume: The rebuilt apron wrap, pocket, straps, rounder limbs and swept hair make useful native improvements. Headband/head integration still prevents a finished all-view construction.
scoreExplanation.color: Original tan/light-amber, brown, red, ivory and blue identity is retained and readable under warmer lighting.
scoreExplanation.lightingHighlights: Broad soft shading improves source faceting and retains profile/rear volume without a directional ground shadow.
scoreExplanation.materialDetail: Clear garment layers and restrained pocket/edge/fastening details improve the chef at use size. The result is a simpler matte finish than the fixed target; that is acceptable.
scoreExplanation.artifactFreeReadability: Face, garment hierarchy and action silhouettes remain readable, but persistent headwear gaps and abrupt hair crossings are visible even at logical size.

observations.observation: Mateo retains his compact source identity, warm tan skin, brown fringe, red headwear/tie, ivory coat and blue apron. Rounder garment edges, a larger shaped pocket, shoulder straps/buttons, back straps and smoother arm/head forms make visible native improvements over the original.

Lighting is soft and coherent on front, both profiles and rear. Broad hair/cheek/cloth highlights, readable eyes and clear ivory/blue separation improve form. Transparent silhouettes remain clean against the three backgrounds; no target halo was copied.

The continuous red upper/side arc sits outside the hair mass with visible background slots in S and N. Along the foreground red band, the fringe produces abrupt dark triangular bites in S and rear hair produces paired round bites in N; profile edges also appear rigidly suspended around the crown. This persists across all action states and reads as an open hoop with intersecting hair rather than a fitted folded bandana.

All original actions and four facings are present. The motion strips and actual playbacks show planted feet, continuous head/arm motion and stable garments/materials with no new visible pose pop. The original packed 2D salmon and work knife retain their source presentation and are not misrepresented as modeled sushi. Native belt/customer previews show the retained source scale and serving composition.

blockers.location: Headband around crown and foreground band, all states; clearest in hero-S.png around native x88–298/y205–331 and hero-N.png around x82–298/y219–333, plus both profiles.
blockers.effect: Visible background gaps separate the upper/side red arc from the hair, while abrupt brown/black notches break the red strip at front and rear. The headwear reads as a rigid loose hoop with cut-throughs, weakening the required folded cloth construction and finished all-view silhouette.
blockers.desiredVisibleOutcome: The red headband should read as fitted folded fabric around the head/hair, with intentional clean hair occlusion, continuous readable cloth edges and a coherent side tie from front, rear and both profiles. Remove the detached-looking background slots and abrupt band bites while preserving native identity, registration, clearance and actions. The editor chooses the native construction.

remainingDifferences: The candidate has a simpler, more matte material finish and smaller eye/gloss accents than the fixed target; these are acceptable within the warm softly lit cartoon direction.
Garment details and proportions differ from the target, and the camera remains the registered source camera instead of the target framing. Useful native apron/strap/pocket changes are accepted.

The original source 2D salmon retains its facing-independent composition and camera-ray depth bias. Its original functional reach beyond the body cell is accepted and is not a defect in native character geometry.

Independently sampled all 192 original cohorts with S0/E+90/N180/W-90 rotations and retained child transforms; evaluated hand/foot bones match the original baseline and palm centroids agree within floating-point tolerance. Stored custom socket strings were not used as contact truth.
technicalEvidence.nativeAndDependencies: Saved candidate contains editable weighted native 3D character geometry, not a target card. The held food is the original packed dish-salmon.png 2D plane, declared as such; source SHA256 5de7475813a133bb643fa9de09adbef104c7bd20a572514a297cba54846ceafe. Supplemental evidence confirms original prop geometry/UV/driver parity and no linked libraries.
technicalEvidence.light: Actual reopened scene uses one centered 150 W area and four equal 75 W cardinal fills with no ground plane; one configuration serves all facings. The pixels show no preferred horizontal shading direction or cast ground shadow.
